exposure: CT attenuation difference (OV CT value minus IVC CT value)
OV/IVC attenuation ratio (OV CT value divided by IVC CT value)
outcome: Diagnosis of Postpartum ovarian vein thrombophlebitis (POVT)
cohort: The study included 34,140 postpartum patients from People's Hospital of Yuxi City, of whom 24 POVT cases and 42 non-POVT puerperal women with complete clinical and CT datasets were analyzed.
finding: Non-contrast CT, combined with semi-quantitative parameters (OV width, thrombus CT value, CT attenuation difference, and OV/IVC attenuation ratio) and D-dimer levels, significantly improved the diagnostic precision for Postpartum ovarian vein thrombophlebitis.
